subject: LaunchCohort voucher stewardship + onboarding ops checklist
messages:
From: Maya Thompson <maya@launchcohort.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@launchcohort.io
Date: 2026-09-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood vouchers for LaunchCohort cohort #22 — proposal

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. LaunchCohort is finalizing cohort #22 (starts Oct 4) and a number of our startups have asked about a sandbox credit bundle they can claim during the 8-week program.

High level ask: 10 vouchers of $5k each, redeemable within 90 days, with a soft usage cap (we typically coordinate a weekly review). We can require the startups to accept your voucher terms. Can Redwood provide a short MOA and an activation flow so we can add it to our partner portal?

Attached: a draft onboarding checklist (LC_Onboarding_Guidelines_v2.pdf) and our standard partner alert template.

We can sign a short MOA if that helps. Looking to get this locked in by Sep 25.

Appreciate it —
Maya
Program Director | LaunchCohort
[Attachment: LC_Onboarding_Guidelines_v2.pdf]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maya Thompson <maya@launchcohort.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vouchers for LaunchCohort cohort #22 — proposal

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the clear ask and the checklist. Quick responses:

- We can provision 10 vouchers at $5k each, redeemable for hosted usage only, valid 90 days from activation.
- We’ll require startups to accept our voucher terms (short form) and we prefer a per-account activation flow tied to an email invite from LaunchCohort.
- Two operational items from our side: we need (1) a named point-of-contact at LaunchCohort for weekly usage syncs and (2) an agreed plan for handling overages (we typically recommend a soft throttle + review rather than unexpected billing).

I’m looping Ben for fulfillment logistics and Lauren for final approval on promotional budget & discount authority. If we can get MOA + list of cohort company names by Sep 23, we should hit the Sep 25 target.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to create voucher batch and share activation URLs (internal).
2) Lauren to approve promotional allowance & sign MOA.
3) Maya to confirm POC and share companies list.

Soojin
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: voucher_terms_short.txt]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: LaunchCohort vouchers — fulfillment notes

Forwarding Maya’s note — I started the internal fulfillment checklist below.

Internal fulfillment checklist (draft):
- Create voucher batch: code prefix LC22- (10 codes)
- Backend flags: hosted_only=true, expiry_days=90, max_redemption_per_code=1
- Activation flow: invite link generation + redirect to signup with voucher pre-applied
- Instrument HubSpot with redemption events (voucher_redeemed) and link to deal DL-7843
- Alerting: weekly usage summary to partners@launchcohort.io and POC email
- Overage policy: soft throttle at 120% of bundle forecast, notify POC and account owner

Questions for Lauren: do we set an aggregate monthly spend cap for the cohort (recommended) or leave it open with monitoring? Also need thumbs on MOA signature authority — do you want to sign or route to legal?

Ben
Sr. Partner Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Maya Thompson <maya@launchcohort.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vouchers for LaunchCohort cohort #22 — approval & MOA

Hi Maya —

Appreciate the patience. I reviewed the proposal and approved a promotional allowance for cohort #22 under the following guardrails: 

1) Voucher details: 10 x $5,000 vouchers, hosted-only, 90-day expiry from activation.
2) Aggregate cap: cohort-level monthly cap of $35,000 (we’ll set soft throttle at token-level and notify POC at 80% usage).
3) Overage handling: any forecasted overages to be discussed in the weekly review; for actual chargeable overages we’ll route to LaunchCohort billing contact after a 7-day notice.
4) MOA: I’ve signed the short MOA. See DocuSign link below for counter-signature. Please complete the MOA by Sep 24 to hit the onboarding timeline.

Action items:
- Soojin: please confirm POC name and provide the list of companies and contact emails.
- Ben: proceed to create voucher batch LC22- and share activation links with partners@launchcohort.io when ready.
- Maya: sign MOA via DocuSign link and confirm POC.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/launchcohort-moa
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/7843

Thanks all — excited to get the cohort going.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales — Strategic Partners | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Signed_MOA_LB.pdf]
